subject: CWE-639
object: The system's authorization functionality does not prevent one user from gaining access to another user's data or record by modifying the key value identifying the data.
object_canonical: the system's authorization functionality does not prevent one user from gaining access to another user's data or record by modifying the key value identifying the data.

subject: CVE-2024-10497
object:
CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability exists that could allow an
authorized attacker to modify values outside those defined by their privileges (Elevation of Privileges) when the
attacker sends modified HTTPS requests to the device.
